```lean
theorem lg_target (a b : ℝ) : 2 * a * b ≤ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by
  have h : (a - b) ^ 2 ≥ 0 := by norm_num
  unfold pow at h
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm, add_left_comm, neg_neg] at h
  rw [add_assoc, add_assoc, add_left_comm] at h
  rw [add_assoc, add_left_comm] at h
  rw [add_assoc] at h
  rw [add_comm a b] at h
  exact h
```
